title: Distribute Repeating Integers
summary: Given an array of n integers with at most 50 unique values and an array of m customer order quantities, determine if it's possible to distribute the integers such that each customer receives exactly their specified quantity of identical integers, and all customers are satisfied.
statement: Given an array of n integers with at most 50 unique values and an array of m customer order quantities, determine if it's possible to distribute the integers such that each customer receives exactly their specified quantity of identical integers, and all customers are satisfied.
constraints: nums has at most 100000 values but at most 50 distinct values; quantity has 1 through 10 positive demands.
Each customer must receive its requested count of one identical integer value.
Different customers may share a value only when its available frequency covers their combined demand.
hints: Compress equal input values into independent capacity buckets.
Represent a set of already satisfied customers by a bitmask.
For each capacity, enumerate subsets of remaining customers whose total demand fits and add them to reachable masks.
Every customer assigned to one value appears in exactly one chosen subset; carrying old masks permits unused values.
editorial: Every customer assigned to one value appears in exactly one chosen subset; carrying old masks permits unused values.

tests.explanation: Every value occurs once, so no customer can receive two identical integers.
Give both ones to one customer and both twos to the other.
